audience: engineering and support teams who run public status pages with Instatus

useCases.title: Check the status of each component on a status page
useCases.text: The AI lists your status pages and the components of one page with their status, so you see which parts are operational and which are not.

useCases.title: Review recent incidents and their update timeline
useCases.text: The AI lists a page's incidents, most recent first and optionally by status, and opens one with its updates and affected components.

useCases.title: Check scheduled maintenances on a status page
useCases.text: The AI lists scheduled maintenances with start and end times and affected components, and opens one to show its update timeline.

useCases.title: Open an incident and set component status
useCases.text: The AI creates an incident with a message and affected components, and sets component status such as DEGRADEDPERFORMANCE or MAJOROUTAGE. This can notify subscribers.

useCases.title: Update or resolve an incident, or schedule maintenance
useCases.text: The AI moves an incident to MONITORING or RESOLVED, or creates a scheduled maintenance event with start and end times. This can notify subscribers.
